Title: Register with valid details then login and verify profile
Preconditions: https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/ is open. Use a new email that is not already registered.
Steps: 1. Open Sign in then Register. | 2. Fill all required fields with valid data and a unique email. | 3. Submit registration. | 4. Log in with the same email and password. | 5. Open Profile.
TestData: First name: Test; Last name: User; Date of birth: age 18-75 inclusive; Email: qa.manual+<timestamp>@example.com; Password: Test@1234; Confirm password: Test@1234; Phone and address: valid values
ExpectedResult: Registration succeeds. Login succeeds with the same credentials. Profile shows the registered name and email.

Title: Reject login with an invalid password
Preconditions: Home page is loaded. Do not use customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com (protects the Smoke account from lockout).
Steps: 1. Open Login. | 2. Enter customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com and WrongPass!1. | 3. Submit. | 4. Attempt to open My Invoices.
ExpectedResult: An error is shown. The user stays logged out. My Invoices is not available.

Title: Search catalog and open an in-stock product
Preconditions: Catalog home is reachable. No login required.
Steps: 1. Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/. | 2. Confirm product cards are visible. | 3. Search for Claw Hammer. | 4. Open that product.
ExpectedResult: Catalog loads. Results include Claw Hammer. PDP shows name, price, and Add to cart.

Title: Add two products to the cart and update quantity
Preconditions: Logged in as customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01. Remove any existing cart lines first so only this test's items remain.
Steps: 1. Search Claw Hammer and add qty 1 from the PDP. | 2. Search Combination Pliers and add qty 1. | 3. Open the cart. | 4. Increase Claw Hammer quantity from 1 to 2. | 5. Check line total and cart subtotal.
TestData: User: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01; Product A: Claw Hammer qty 1 then 2; Product B: Combination Pliers qty 1
ExpectedResult: Cart shows two line items. After qty update Claw Hammer line total equals unit price x 2 and the subtotal includes both products.

Title: Complete Cash on Delivery checkout Confirm twice and verify the invoice
Preconditions: Logged in as customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01. Cart contains Claw Hammer (qty 2) and Combination Pliers (qty 1) from TC-MAN-04 or the same setup. Note current My Invoices count before checkout.
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout and confirm the summary matches the cart. | 2. Select Cash on Delivery and complete billing fields. | 3. Place order. | 4. Click Confirm. | 5. Click Confirm a second time. | 6. Open My Invoices and open the invoice that lists Claw Hammer and Combination Pliers.
TestData: Payment: Cash on Delivery; Confirm clicks: 2; Billing: valid street city state country postal code
ExpectedResult: Order is placed. After the second Confirm an invoice exists under My Invoices for these two products with qty 2 and 1 and payment Cash on Delivery. One Confirm is not enough.

Title: Block COD checkout when a mandatory billing field is blank
Preconditions: Logged in. Cart has at least one in-stock product. Note My Invoices count.
Steps: 1. Go to checkout. | 2. Select Cash on Delivery. | 3. Leave postal code blank. | 4. Attempt to place the order.
TestData: Payment: Cash on Delivery; Postal code: (empty); Other billing fields: valid
ExpectedResult: Validation error on the missing field. No order is placed. Invoice count is unchanged.

Title: Do not generate an invoice after a single Confirm
Preconditions: Logged in. Cart has at least one in-stock product. Complete COD checkout until the Confirm step. Note My Invoices list.
Steps: 1. Place a COD order to reach Confirm. | 2. Click Confirm only once. | 3. Open My Invoices. | 4. Check that no new invoice was created for this attempt.
TestData: Payment: Cash on Delivery; Confirm clicks: 1
ExpectedResult: After one Confirm the invoice is not listed (or remains incomplete). A second Confirm is required to generate the invoice.
